text: Aircraft conflict refers to predicted conflict of two aircraft, or between aircraft and airspace. A red alert is used for conflicts when the predicted minimum separation is 5 nautical miles or less. A yellow alert indicates the minimum separation is between 5 and approximately 12 nautical miles. A blue is used for conflicts between an aircraft and predefined airspace. Question. Which conflict alert will sound when the minimum separation is 8 nautical miles?
